page: Amazon Web Services c8id.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It includes 950 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps, running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-threaded performance, with Geekbench single-core scoring 2219.0 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 34.49 GB/sec. Text processing is a notable strength, achieving a top-tier Geekbench text processing score of 2967.0. For machine learning workloads, the instance demonstrates top-tier text generation speeds of 390.86 tokens per second using a small 135M LLM model, though performance scales down to 17.16 tokens per second for a medium 7B model. Multi-core and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally fall within the average range, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 17299.69 and a large-block memory write speed of 71.98 GB/sec.

The c8id.4xlarge offers high compute density and fast local storage, making it highly cost-efficient for workloads that require rapid scratch space and high CPU performance without massive memory footprints. However, with only 2.0 GB of RAM per core, it is less suited for memory-intensive databases or large-scale data analytics. The presence of advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX accelerates vector and matrix operations. This instance is well-suited for high-performance web serving, text processing, software compilation, and light machine learning inference.
description: Amazon Web Services c8id.4xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance featuring an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 16 vCPUs, 8 physical cores, and a 3.9 GHz clock speed. It is configured with 32.0 GB of DDR5 memory and 950 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, running on the Nitro hypervisor. The instance delivers strong single-core performance, highlighted by a Geekbench single-core score of 2219.0 and top-tier text processing capabilities. While its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio limits memory-heavy applications, its hardware-accelerated instruction sets, including Intel AMX and AVX-512, optimize it for compute-intensive tasks. This profile makes the c8id.4xlarge highly suitable for workloads such as software compilation, text processing, static web serving, and small-scale machine learning inference where high-speed local storage and dedicated CPU resources are required.
